target_customer: IP law firms and in-house IP teams handling patent litigation and portfolio analysis
problem: Patent invalidity, infringement and freedom-to-operate work is slow and manual. Stilta uses agents that trace each finding to sources.
business_model: B2B software for IP teams (pricing not stated)

founders.name: Oscar Adamsson
education: Chalmers and other Swedish universities, degrees in business and AI
coursework at UC Berkeley and Bocconi

founders.name: Tobias Estreen
founders.background_notes: Physics and machine learning background per YC page.

investors: founders and operators from Sana, Legora, OpenAI, Lovable and Listen Labs

competitors.name: Patlytics
competitors.what: AI patent analysis, named by the CEO as closest competitor

competitors.name: Solve Intelligence
competitors.what: patent AI focused on drafting and prosecution

technical_complexity.rationale: Agents searching 180 million patents plus literature with traceable citations need solid retrieval engineering, but rely on available models.

defensibility.rationale: Litigation workflows and source-backed outputs may create stickiness, but several patent AI rivals were funded and building.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbents hold data but, per one analysis, lack the agentic product. No action against Stilta reported.

market_need_then: Patent litigation is high-value and document-heavy. The company reports customers or pilots including Roche, Alfa Laval and Maersk, as stated in its own release.

identity.visual_style: A freelance designer lists brand and web design work for Stilta.
identity.voice_and_tone: Positions itself as 'Cursor for patent practitioners'.

branding.community_and_virality: Wide funding coverage in legal tech and tech press.

brand_strength.rationale: Distinctive coined name with good funding press, but searches confuse it with Stilla and Stila.

outcome_analysis: Stilta joined YC in Winter 2026 and announced a $10.5M round led by Andreessen Horowitz in late May 2026, its first outside funding, with pilots at large industrial customers. It is Active with no exit or shutdown found. Strong consulting-trained team and fast fundraising support the factors, though funded rivals remain.
notes: Round stage is called seed in headlines from a legal tech outlet and a Pulse article; legaltechnology.com does not name the stage. Founding date conflicts across sources (December 2025, January or February 2026). Amount confirmed by several outlets. Exact day of announcement not given. A search for shutdown or lawsuit found nothing about Stilta.
